summary:
ServiceNow 本季 EPS 低於預期14.4%，但營收年增22%，成長故事未變。
• EPS 0.45 美元，低於預估0.53（-14.41%）。
• 營收3.77億美元（B級），年增22.09%維持高成長。
• 企業數位工作流與 AI（Now Assist）需求強勁。
• EPS miss 可能來自投資加碼或一次性費用，而非需求疲弱。
ai_view:
訊號分歧：EPS 低於預期但營收維持22%高速成長，呈現「成長強、獲利端有雜訊」的組合，需釐清 miss 是來自策略性投資或費用認列。短期股價對 EPS 失望敏感，但高營收成長與訂閱模式提供基本面支撐。中期關鍵在 Now Assist（GenAI）變現與 cRPO 動能。追蹤指標：訂閱營收年增、cRPO、淨擴張率（NRR）與營業利潤率指引。62倍本益比下，市場更看重成長與 AI 兌現。

需留意：本益比62.42偏高，EPS miss 短期恐引發波動。；AI 投資加碼可能持續壓抑短期利潤率。；大型企業 IT 預算循環性風險。

summary_en:
ServiceNow missed EPS by 14.4% but grew revenue 22%, leaving the growth story intact.
• EPS of $0.45 missed the $0.53 estimate by 14.41%.
• Revenue of $3.77B grew a strong 22.09% year over year.
• Enterprise digital workflow and AI (Now Assist) demand is robust.
• The EPS miss may stem from heavier investment or one-offs, not weak demand.

ai_view_en:
Signal is mixed: an EPS miss alongside sustained 22% revenue growth shows a strong-growth, noisy-earnings combination; the miss's source (strategic investment vs. expense timing) needs clarity. Near-term the stock is sensitive to EPS disappointment, but high revenue growth and the subscription model provide fundamental support. Mid-term hinges on Now Assist (GenAI) monetization and cRPO momentum. Track subscription revenue growth, cRPO, net revenue retention, and margin guidance. At 62x, the market prizes growth and AI delivery.

Watch：A high P/E of 62.42 means the EPS miss could spur near-term volatility.; Heavier AI investment may keep pressuring near-term margins.; Large-enterprise IT budget cyclicality poses risk.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 較預估低14.41%，惟營收年增22.09%維持高速成長。
